label: #509 first logical slice
summary:
#509 first logical slice. An accurate performed denial of all episodes is impossible: the performed token is itself a witness against its content. An empty interpretation where no token occurs shows no unconditional existence claim follows; a static one-episode interpretation shows occurrence does not force temporal variation. Neither experiential succession nor Aristotelian reduction from potency to act is derived. The retorsion is a structural implication about accurate performances, not independent evidence that any performance occurs in the actual world, and it cannot yet satisfy the #500 retorsion or observation floor for STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD.
